limitations: Only nondegenerate ideal tetrahedra in \(\mathbb H^3\) are covered. Stability is measured by Euclidean squared deviation of the three dihedral angles. No finite, hyperideal, generalized, higher-dimensional, or intrinsic-moduli analogue is claimed.
provenance: Scientific theorem, proof, literature comparison, and reproducibility evidence where present.
record_title: Sharp angle-variance profile for ideal tetrahedron volume
